# `explode`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Separates the elements of array `expr` into multiple rows, or the elements of map `expr` into multiple rows and columns. Unless specified otherwise, uses the default column name `col` for elements of the array or `key` and `value` for the elements of the map.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
explode(expr)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `generator_funcs` |
| Kind | generator (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- explode, example 1
> SELECT explode(array(10, 20));
10
20
```

```sql
-- explode, example 2
> SELECT explode(collection => array(10, 20));
10
20
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
